scope: TRAIN-only nested LOMO; every outer match excluded from all inner training, policy selection, and fusion fitting; TEST/VALIDATION not accessed
models: Temporal RandomForest and net_motion RandomForest (300 trees, min_samples_leaf=2, balanced, random_state=42); visual LogisticRegression on frozen ResNet18 embeddings; fusion LogisticRegression on cross-fitted temporal+visual scores
selection_rule: maximize aggregate covered catalog goals, then minimize unique video-minutes, then segments, then use lower grid complexity order
warning: Outer LOMO estimates this frozen policy-selection procedure on TRAIN development data; not independent validation and not a promotion decision.

nested_lomo_result.baseline_reference: Temporal Top-60/gap45 with prior match-held-out rank_score on the same 5,372 common groups; reference scores use the archived LOMO ranker, while nested scores retrain models inside folds, so the comparison is contextual rather than an identical paired model fit.
nested_lomo_result.decision: GO only to one-time VALIDATION confirmation; NO promotion to V4 or TEST from TRAIN LOMO.
